apps.localizedDescription:
Aventuras:

Interactive fiction with an AI that remembers. Play a text adventure or write collaboratively, on desktop and Android, with any LLM provider you like — cloud or running on your own machine.

Aventuras keeps the story straight: chapters are summarized as you play, a lorebook feeds the right entries into the right scene, an agent tidies that lorebook behind you, and the world state — who is present, where you are, what you carry — is tracked turn by turn.

Highlights:

• Two modes — Adventure, with multiple-choice actions and world tracking; Creative Writing, freeform with AI suggestions. First/second/third person, past or present tense.

versions.localizedDescription:
👋 New Contributors:

• @TheDWz made their first contribution in #541.

💥 Breaking:

• Prompt Pack: default templates changed (Lore Management, Interactive Lorebook, Adventure Mode, Creative Writing Mode, Action Choices, Opening Generation and Opening Refinement (Adventure, Creative Writing)). Only the built-in pack updates itself. If you've edited these, use a custom or imported pack, or have a story system prompt using {{ lengthInstruction }}, check the linked PRs for update steps (#528, #534, #577, #530, #538).

✨ Features:

• iOS and iPadOS (16.4+): an unsigned .ipa for sideloading with AltStore, Sideloadly or TrollStore, plus fixes for iPad detection, backup restore and ComfyUI (#541, #559).
• Story time: a Timeline tab flags time anomalies and lets you anchor, edit and reconcile entry times. New stories and scenarios start at a time you set (#530).
• Chapter banners in the story view (Interface → Show Chapter Banners), with chapter starts in the navigation panel (#575).
• Entry numbers on Memory panel chapters (click to jump) and, via Appearance → Show Entry Number and Time, on each narration (#520).
• Edit a story's title, genre and description from its library card, and pick a genre badge colour (#526).
• Lore Management reads the just-written chapter in full and continues from its end (#528, #534, #590).
• Vault assistant knows the current state of the character, lorebook or scenario it was opened from (#577).
• Gallery newest-first toggle (#589).

🐛 Fixes:

• Stories set to Text Only, or with no saved image mode, no longer generate images (#554).
• The story wizard keeps the Response Length and Narrator Reinforcement you pick (#570).
• Fixed crashes on a character with a repeated trait and on wizard results with duplicate names. Repeated traits, aliases and keywords now merge regardless of case (#585, #587).
• Fixed importing a Vault lorebook into a story, and a lorebook file import now writes to the open branch, not main (#587, #588).
• Scene-analysis portraits show up right away, respect branches, and don't overwrite one you set (#564).
• Vault assistant tool calls show their own pending changes when several run together (#576).
• Hover-only buttons that were invisible but tappable on touch devices are now shown, touchscreen laptops included (#553, #558).
• Android: the keyboard no longer covers the page, and edge swipes no longer eat taps on the panel button and Send (#521).

🔧 Improvements:

• Exported Vault characters, scenarios and lorebooks import back exactly, with no AI call (#539).
• The activity report says why each step failed, request by request, and keeps the last 20 turns (#569).
• The Style Reviewer ignores image prompts, HTML and headers, so it stops advising the narrator on markup (#560).
• Response Length wording comes from the prompt pack (#538).
• In-story years and days count from 1, so existing times read one higher (#530).
• OLED theme accent is light grey; icon buttons get screen-reader labels (#575, #589).
